messages:
maria: Kicking off POC for ProspectCo — they asked for SSO/SAML, SCIM provisioning (users+groups), RBAC mapping, and domain proofing. Can we confirm owners and a minimal deliverable list? (CC @sam @raj)

sam: I can lead SE side. Need answers on SAML IdP metadata format and whether they require Encrypted Assertions.

lisa - ProspectCo: They use Okta, require signed assertions, not encrypted. Session timeout 8h. SCIM: delta sync enabled, group push required.

raj: Security checklist: SOC2 Type II status? Also need KMS usage for keys, SCIM webhook signing, and audit log retention policy. I'll start filling the questionnaire.

maria: Lisa said SOC2 Type II available. For KMS, they need customer-managed keys (BYOK). That’s a Private/Dedicated capability — @sam confirm pricing delta.

sam: Hosted API supports BYOK on enterprise tier but Dedicated gives stronger isolation + KMS/HSM integration. Pricing uplift approx +35% MRC + usage. I’ll get exact numbers from pricing.

maria: Proposed POC scope (2 weeks): 1) SAML SSO end-to-end, 2) SCIM full + delta with 10k users, 3) RBAC group->role mapping tests, 4) domain proofing + verified email claim. Owners: sam (SE) infra & test harness, raj (Security) questionnaire & diagram, maria (AE) coordination.

deploy-bot: deploy started: prod-poc/prospectco/session-v1 on dedicated-cluster-3 (ETA 18m)

sam: SCIM rate-limit note — recommend testing 60 reqs/min with burst handling. Sample SCIM PATCH for group membership mapping: 

sam: ```
PATCH /scim/v2/Groups/123
{ 
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],
  "Operations": [ {"op":"add","path":"members","value":[{"value":"2819c223-7f76-453a-919d-413861904646","display":"jdoe"}]} ]
}
```

lisa - ProspectCo: OK on rate limits; we’ll simulate 12k users. For RBAC they want SAML groups -> internal roles mapping and restrict admin role to domain-verified users only.

maria: Action items: sam to produce test IdP metadata + SP metadata; raj to upload security questionnaire responses to shared doc; sam to create pricing quote (POC vs production Dedicated) and note EU region constraint. ETA Wed COB.

raj: Also need to confirm audit log retention (they want 12 months) and an architecture diagram showing where keys are stored and who has access. I’ll request the diagram from infra.

sam: SP metadata uploaded: https://redwood.docs/poc/prospectco/sp-metadata.xml — includes ACS url, entityID, and signing cert.

maria: Thanks. I'll loop in legal/AE for contract language on data residency. Anyone foresee technical blockers? :eyes: 

lisa - ProspectCo: Legal flagged data residency for EU end-users as blocker. They require EU-only processing and contractual guarantees. Can we run the POC in a Dedicated EU region?

maria: Noted — adding region constraint to quote and POC plan.

sam: Confirmed: Dedicated and Private deployments support SCIM delta, group caching, and region pinning by default. We can enable EU Dedicated cluster for the POC.

maria: Perfect. Wrapping up — I'll update the shared tracker with owners and timeline. Closing thread after Wed updates. Cheers :rocket:
